clips.send: Seven kingdoms with seven kinds of money, different writing and even different widths of cart axle: how do you turn them into one country? In 221 BCE the king of Qin (秦 Qín, said “chin”) did it in about ten years and called himself First Emperor. The Han (汉 Hàn) dynasty that followed lasted over 400 years and was about as big and as populous as the Roman Empire on the other side of the world.

clips.send: 推恩令允许诸侯王把封地分给子弟，王国越分越小，势力被削弱。
